title: 3D Ballistic Projectile Motion with Spin & Restitution
description: A 0.8 kg steel sphere is launched in 3D space at 6.8 m/s (elevation 52 deg, azimuth 18 deg) with initial backspin angular momentum, following a 3D parabola under gravity and aerodynamic drag before bouncing on a concrete floor (e=0.68).
tavily_query: coefficient of restitution and friction steel on concrete physical constant
laws_tested: Conservation of linear and angular momentum at 3D floor impact
Contact constraints (3D floor plane z >= radius)
Friction and aerodynamic drag energy dissipation
